audit.whatIsWrong: The page treated Rune Prison as an unconditional 'point-blank root' you dodge. It is targeted — you cannot dodge it — and it only ROOTS if Spell Flux is already on you; without Flux it is a slow.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' That single condition decides whether Diana's step-in is punished or merely slowed, and it was never stated anywhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Spell Flux is the tell, not Rune Prison. Step in unfluxed and the W is a slow you walk through; step in fluxed and you are held for the Overload chain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content told you to 'punish every Q cooldown'. Overload is a flat 5s and his other basic abilities reset it, so there is no reliable Q window to punish.
audit.why: Riot's text: Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune.
audit.corrected: His spike is the first mana item, not a cooldown gap; yours are Lunar Rush at 3 and Moonfall at 6 (100/90/80) against Realm Warp's 180/160/140.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four full-layer sides disagreed with the content layer and the packet: rows 0, 3, 5 and 6.
audit.why: Packet and win[] both read Diana / Diana / Diana / Diana / Diana / Ryze / Diana. Row 5 to Ryze is right on the kit — his first mana item is what turns Flux into a real root-and-burst chain.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned with each moved row's why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles, and the cooldowns field held no digit.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to their own titles; cooldowns field now carries Rune Prison 11s/9s, Spell Flux 3.5s/2.5s and Overload's flat 5s with its reset.

Look to snowball a kill or two in this window since Ryze scales much harder than he starts.
